name: Hoodie bundle promos settings
description: Configure hoodie bundles and the Promo of the Day
title: Hoodie bundle & Promo of the Day
helpText: Hoodie pairs always run first. Then the selected Promo of the Day applies to remaining items.
bundlePriceNote: Any two units from the hoodie collection sell for this fixed total in shop currency. Discount is split proportionally. Lines with _hoodie_bundle_exclude are skipped.
b2g1Help: 2 paid units unlock 1 unit at the discount percent (cheapest first, multi-use). Leave collections empty to apply to all products.
b1g50Help: 1 paid unit unlocks 1 unit at the discount percent (cheapest first, multi-use). Leave collections empty to apply to all products.
b1hg50SwHelp: 1 full-price unit from the qualifying collection (typically hoodies) unlocks the cheapest eligible unit (typically sweatpants) at the discount percent. Multi-use. Collections required.
spendSavePercentCsvHelp: Shop-currency spend|percent pairs, comma-separated. Example: 75|20,150|25,200|30. Converted with presentment rate.
spendSaveFixedCsvHelp: Shop-currency spend|discount-cents pairs, comma-separated. Example: 75|1500,150|4000,200|6000. Converted with presentment rate.
